name: Saved Posts Library & Export
description: Capture links and details from posts you saved, browse a local library, and download selected media. Not affiliated with Instagram.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://*.cdninstagram.com https://*.fbcdn.net; img-src 'self' data: https://*.cdninstagram.com https://*.fbcdn.net; media-src 'self' blob: https://*.cdninstagram.com https://*.fbcdn.net
